quote: The SPA is governed by New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in New York County courts. ... But the Side Letter— which by the order of precedence (SPA § 11.11) controls over the SPA—selects Delaware law and exclusive jurisdiction in the Court of Chancery of Delaware for all indemnification disputes.
reason: The memo pins the conflict to the correct provisions: Side Letter § 6, which picks Delaware law and the Court of Chancery for indemnification disputes, against SPA §§ 11.8–11.9, which pick New York law and New York County courts. It also explains that the § 11.11 precedence clause makes the Side Letter control. It describes the result as a split, with indemnity claims under Article IX going to a different law and forum, which brings uncertainty and parallel proceedings. Finally, it recommends conforming the Side Letter to New York.
